What Is Sola Salon Studios?

Sola Salon Studios is a well-known salon-suite business model built around individual, fully private studios that independent hair, skin, and beauty professionals lease and run as their own small businesses. That structure changes how pricing, scheduling, and specialties work compared to a traditional full-service salon — details we break down across this guide.

This site exists to make that model easier to navigate before you book — covering what to expect, how pricing actually works, and how to evaluate an independent professional with confidence.

Read the full guide
Real spaces

Every Studio Looks Different

That's the point of the salon-studio model — each professional designs and runs their own space. A few real examples of the range you'll find, from minimalist to maximalist.

There's no single "look" you should expect walking in, which is part of why researching the specific professional matters more here than the location's general reputation.

Frequently Asked Questions

The questions below come up most often from people researching the salon-studio model for the first time. Each links to a fuller guide if you want more detail than the short answer here provides.

What is a Sola Salon Studio?+

Sola Salon Studios is a salon-suite concept where independent beauty professionals rent their own private studio space rather than working as employees of a traditional salon.

How are salon studio services typically priced?+

Pricing is set individually by each independent professional, so it varies by stylist experience, location, and the specific service performed rather than a single company-wide price list.

How can I find a salon studio near me?+

You can search by city or ZIP code, browse studio directories, or ask for referrals. Our near-me guide walks through practical ways to search.

How much should I budget for a haircut?+

Costs vary widely by region and stylist experience. Use our Salon Cost Calculator for a rough, informational estimate before you book.
